name: Tabs
description: Tabs for switching between panels of related content on the same page. They can be used fully from the keyboard.

classes.ayy-tabs--sm: Small: the track is a small control tall, tab text is control sm, tighter padding. Reaches only its own list, not tabs nested in a panel.
classes.ayy-tabs--lg: Large: the track is a large control tall, tab text is control lg, more padding.
classes.ayy-tabs__panel: role="tabpanel". Hide inactive panels with the hidden attribute.
classes.ayy-tabs__count: Small count after a tab's label (items in a filter). Inverts with the selected tab.

default.looks: A pill track (wash fill, line border) with text-soft tab labels.

hover.looks: Tab label turns full text colour.

pressed.none: No pressed look; it selects on click.

disabled.looks: --ayy-opacity-disabled, not-allowed cursor; arrow keys skip it. Forced colours: GrayText.

selected.looks: Filled with the text colour, label in the page colour, small shadow; its count gets a 15% page-colour tint. Forced colours: Highlight.

error.none: No error look; show it in the panel.

loading.none: Show loading in the panel (Skeleton), not on the tab.

scale.sm: Track at the sm control height (28px compact, 32 comfortable, 40 touch), control sm text, 8px side padding.
scale.md: Track at the md control height (32px compact, 40 comfortable, 44 touch), control md text, 12px side padding.
scale.lg: Track at the lg control height (36px compact, 44 comfortable, 48 touch), control lg text, 16px side padding.

sizes.density: Every size follows data-density with the control scale.
sizes.width: The list hugs its tabs and scrolls sideways when they don't fit; panels fill the container.

js: tabsClass/tabsListClass/tabsTabClass/tabsPanelClass/tabsCountClass constants; tabsSizeClass(size?) → string | undefined (the --sm / --lg class for the root; md adds nothing); nextTabIndex(key, current, count, rtl) for custom keyboard handling.

attributes.value: The selected tab's data-value (or index). Two-way.
attributes.class: Put ayy-tabs on it for block layout.

events.ayy-value-change: { value: string } — the user picked a tab

element.children: A [role=tablist] of [role=tab] buttons and [role=tabpanel] panels, paired by data-value (or by order). Ids, aria-controls/labelledby, tabindex and hidden are managed for you.

react.import: import { Tabs, TabsList, TabsTrigger, TabsContent } from "@danitesler/ayywi/react";

props.size: "sm" | "md" | "lg" — the height of the tab list and its labels.

props.icon: ReactNode — optional icon before the label.

props.keepMounted: Keep children mounted while hidden. Default false.

a11y: Arrow keys move between tabs (flipped in RTL), Home/End jump to first/last. Activation follows focus.
Only the selected tab is in the tab order (roving tabindex).
Give the tablist an aria-label when there's no visible heading.
do: Use tabs to switch views of the same object (Overview / Activity / Members) or as segmented filters with 2–6 options.
Keep tab labels to one or two words.
Keep the tab set stable — don't add/remove tabs based on content.
dont: Don't use tabs for page-level navigation between routes — use links.
Don't use tabs for sequential steps — use Steps and separate pages. For a filter that changes one view (Today / Upcoming), use a Segmented control.
Don't use tabs for more than ~6 options.
